subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should OpenClaw expose context-engine status, doctor, and rotate as a core Gateway/plugin control API after the session-targeting and failure-containment blockers are fixed?
rationale: The mechanical bugs are repairable, but the PR creates a new public Gateway surface and optional ContextEngine plugin contract with operator/admin control semantics that automation should not accept as product direction on its own.

options.title: Approve after blockers fixed
options.body: Keep the proposed core API direction, but require canonical session targeting, contained plugin-hook failures, focused regression tests, branch refresh, and maintainer-reviewed docs/scope semantics before merge.

options.title: Narrow the first API
options.body: Land only read-scoped capabilities/status/doctor first and defer admin rotate until maintainers are ready to own that operator action.

options.title: Defer core control
options.body: Pause or close the PR and keep context-engine maintenance control plugin-private until a broader Gateway control contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve after blockers fixed
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed core API direction, but require canonical session targeting, contained plugin-hook failures, focused regression tests, branch refresh, and maintainer-reviewed docs/scope semantics before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses Gateway session ownership, operator method scopes, and context-engine contracts where current-main history points to vincentkoc as the closest routing owner.
